def test_filter_by_substring():
    # basic match
    assert filter_by_substring(["apple", "banana", "cherry"], "an") == ["banana"]
    # multiple matches preserve order
    assert filter_by_substring(["cat", "car", "dog", "scar"], "ca") == ["cat", "car", "scar"]
    # no match
    assert filter_by_substring(["a", "b"], "z") == []
    # empty substring matches everything
    assert filter_by_substring(["a", "b"], "") == ["a", "b"]
    # empty input
    assert filter_by_substring([], "a") == []
    # substring equal to whole element
    assert filter_by_substring(["abc"], "abc") == ["abc"]
    # case sensitivity
    assert filter_by_substring(["Apple"], "apple") == []
    # does not mutate input
    data = ["apple", "banana"]
    filter_by_substring(data, "an")
    assert data == ["apple", "banana"]
